resources.title: VPC & Subnet Planning Worksheet
resources.description: A fill-in-the-blanks worksheet for planning a VPC before touching the console, built around Lesson 9's own example — CIDR planning, the public-vs-private subnet rule of thumb, and the actual route-table check that decides whether a subnet is really public.

resources.chapterTitle: IAM Deep Dive for Data Engineers
resources.title: Least-Privilege IAM Policy Templates
resources.description: Real, scoped IAM trust and permissions policies for a three-stage ingestion pipeline (ingestion Lambda, Glue transform job, analyst read-only role), grounded in Lesson 13's own example — including a cross-account assume-role template with an external ID condition.

resources.title: AWS CLI: Deploy, Verify, Clean Up — Cheat Sheet
resources.description: The exact deploy/verify/clean-up command loop Lesson 17 walks through by hand, collected as a quick reference, plus the named-profile and `s3 sync` commands from Lesson 15 you'll actually reach for day to day — with a command-to-IAM-action map for predicting an AccessDenied before you hit one.
